Surcharges & customs

What can change the price, and who pays what. We tell you before you agree.

1. Chargeable weight

We charge on the higher of the actual weight and the volumetric weight. Volumetric weight = length × width × height (cm) ÷ 5000.

Example: a box of 40 × 30 × 30 cm weighing 5 kg. Volumetric weight = 36,000 ÷ 5000 = 7.2 kg. You are charged for 7.2 kg, not 5 kg.

Prices are indicative and in IDR; the exact amount depends on destination and is confirmed in your quote. If a charge is only found after shipment (for example a wrong address or a remote area), it is billed to the sender and is due within 7 days of the invoice. Duties and taxes at the destination are separate: the receiver pays them unless agreed otherwise in writing.

3. Duties & taxes at the destination

Import duties and taxes are set by the destination country. By default the receiver pays them. If the receiver refuses to pay, the duties, taxes and the cost of returning or destroying the goods are billed to the sender.

DDU (Delivered Duty Unpaid) = the receiver pays duties and taxes. This is our default.
DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) = the sender pays them in advance. Only available if we agree in writing first. Ask us on WhatsApp.

4. Documents and customs

  • For goods: a commercial invoice and a packing list. We help you prepare them.
  • Declare contents and value truthfully. Costs and fines from a wrong declaration are the sender's responsibility.
  • Customs delays are outside our control and are not grounds for a claim.
  • Lithium batteries and dangerous goods are only accepted after our written approval. See prohibited and restricted items.

5. Tax on our price

Our prices carry no VAT (PPN) at present.
